title: The item wheel opens in the Undercroft
why: His order 2026-10-15: the wheel is accessible in the Undercroft, even though nothing can be used there. A held Q on the floor opens the same eight slot ring with the counts from what the stash packs. The floor has nothing to use, so letting go on a slot says so in one line and closes; the hint reads Release to close. The wheel stays shut under a window, the backpack, the title and the pause box.
now: Hold Q on the Undercroft floor to see the item wheel.
